capabilities: Render a kanban board from markdown files' **Status:** fields
Drag cards between status columns to write the change back to the file
Edit status and horizon values via inline pickers and cycle commands
Search and filter items by id, title, status, horizon, and milestone
Adapt views to the project's mode set in state/phase.yaml
disambiguation: Not a general kanban plugin for any markdown; it only renders files using SweetClaude's bold-key convention (I-*, BL-*, MS-* artifacts).
extras: Only works with SweetClaude-structured vaults; cannot create new items (that is the framework's job via /sweetclaude:project-issues); documents a SweetClaude cache-staleness caveat after Obsidian-side edits, warns against Obsidian's 'Rename vault' for .sweetclaude/ vaults, and notes Windows/Linux vault-picker steps are unverified.
problem: SweetClaude projects tracked as markdown artifacts have no board or table view inside Obsidian; changing an item's status normally means hand-editing bold-key fields in each file.

relations.evidence: SweetClaude in Claude Code remains the primary working interface — Kandyban is a visibility and ergonomics layer alongside it.
The plugin's structure derives from the Obsidian sample plugin template, heavily rewritten.

summary: Kanban board and list view over SweetClaude-convention markdown project files that reads bold-key metadata, supports drag-and-drop status changes, and writes back without touching surrounding content.
